newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF eyes Siemens unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF eyes Siemens unit - paper.

text.p: French defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF is interested in Siemens AG's defence electronics business, the newspaper La Tribune reported on Tuesday, citing anonymous sources in Thomson-CSF management.
"Thomson-CSF's management acknowledges a very keen interest in the sale of Siemens Defence," the newspaper said.
Siemens said this month that the unit had hired a U.S. investment bank to help find a buyer or venture partner.

La Tribune said Thomson-CSF, which is in the process of privatisation, is looking for a German partner and already has ties with Siemens as its Thomson-CSF Airsys business is expected to link up with Siemens Plessey by summer in an Air Traffic Management venture.
